description: Make an incoming webhook: a URL a third party (Twitch, a payment provider, n8n…) calls with a JSON body, and Neblla hands that body to a room — its server file hears neblla.room.on("hook", ({ name, data }) => …) on the Fogs — or, with to: "user", to the user named in the call (?user=<their id in the app>), or, with to: "inbox", leaves it as a notice in the app's Buzón (People › Inbox) even when nobody is connected: the hook's name as sender, a readable line of the body (its message/text/title, else its first values) and the body as data; it cannot be answered, and past the inbox cap per sender the oldest notice goes. Needs the inbox module. To get an event of the app itself there (a purchase, a refund…), make an API secret with this URL as base and point an outgoing webhook at it. The URL carries a token shown only now; making it again with the same name gives a new token (the old URL stops working). Up to 20 per app; 64 KB per call; 60 calls a minute per hook. Answers: 200 { delivered }, 404 hook_not_found, 409 room_not_live / user_not_online / feature_disabled (to: "inbox" with the inbox module off). No server of yours needed.

name.description: Hook name: a letter, then letters, digits, _ or - (≤ 40)

to.description: Who gets it: a room (its server file), the user named in each call, or the app's Buzón
